title: Reader settings tabs scroll away with long TTS settings content
symptom: In a constrained reader settings panel, scrolling the long TTS settings body down to the timer presets could move the `阅读 / 朗读` settings tabs out of the visible area. A Pixel 8 / Android 14 Compose regression reproduced the issue by scrolling to `120 分钟`; the node with content description `设置分页：阅读，未选中` was no longer displayed before the fix.
root_cause: ReaderSettingsSheet placed the tab row and the active settings body inside the same verticalScroll Column. Long tab content therefore scrolled the navigation tabs away with the body content, making tab switching harder after inspecting lower settings controls.
fix: Changed ReaderSettingsSheet so the outer Column keeps ReaderSettingsTabRow outside the scrollable area.
Moved vertical scrolling to the active settings body below the tab row.
Added an instrumented Compose regression that constrains sheet height, scrolls to the bottom TTS timer option, and asserts both settings tabs remain visible.
failed_attempts: A raw swipe gesture in the test did not reliably scroll far enough to prove the issue; using performScrollTo on the bottom timer option produced a stable reproduction.
Asserting that settings tabs render initially is insufficient because the bug appears only after interacting with long settings content.
impact: Keeps settings navigation stable while users inspect or change lower TTS options, reducing interaction dead ends in the compact reader overlay.
